attendance_records_note_length.name: attendance_records_note_length
attendance_records_note_length.value: "attendance_records"."note" is null or char_length("attendance_records"."note") between 1 and 200

enrollments_roll_unique_open.name: enrollments_roll_unique_open
enrollments_roll_unique_open.where: "enrollments"."ends_on" is null and "enrollments"."roll_no" is not null

fee_adjustments_decision.name: fee_adjustments_decision
fee_adjustments_decision.value: ("fee_adjustments"."status" = 'pending') = ("fee_adjustments"."decided_at" is null) and ("fee_adjustments"."decided_at" is null) = ("fee_adjustments"."decided_by" is null) and ("fee_adjustments"."decided_by" is null or "fee_adjustments"."decided_by" <> "fee_adjustments"."requested_by") and (("fee_adjustments"."status" = 'approved') = ("fee_adjustments"."ledger_entry_id" is not null))

fee_concessions_value.name: fee_concessions_value
fee_concessions_value.value: ("fee_concessions"."kind" = 'percent' and "fee_concessions"."value" between 1 and 10000) or ("fee_concessions"."kind" = 'amount' and "fee_concessions"."value" between 1 and 100000000)

fee_concessions_decision.name: fee_concessions_decision
fee_concessions_decision.value: ("fee_concessions"."status" = 'pending') = ("fee_concessions"."decided_at" is null) and ("fee_concessions"."decided_at" is null) = ("fee_concessions"."decided_by" is null) and ("fee_concessions"."decided_by" is null or "fee_concessions"."decided_by" <> "fee_concessions"."requested_by")

fee_structures_approval.name: fee_structures_approval
fee_structures_approval.value: ("fee_structures"."status" = 'draft') = ("fee_structures"."approved_at" is null) and ("fee_structures"."approved_at" is null) = ("fee_structures"."approved_by" is null)

homework_instructions_length.name: homework_instructions_length
homework_instructions_length.value: "homework"."instructions" is null or char_length("homework"."instructions") between 1 and 5000

ledger_entries_sign.name: ledger_entries_sign
ledger_entries_sign.value: ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('charge', 'late_fee', 'refund') and "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" > 0) or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'payment' and "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" < 0) or "ledger_entries"."kind" in ('adjustment', 'reversal')

ledger_entries_memo_length.name: ledger_entries_memo_length
ledger_entries_memo_length.value: "ledger_entries"."memo" is null or char_length("ledger_entries"."memo") between 1 and 200

membership_invitations_relationship.name: membership_invitations_relationship
membership_invitations_relationship.value: ("membership_invitations"."student_id" is null) = ("membership_invitations"."relationship" is null) and ("membership_invitations"."relationship" is null or "membership_invitations"."relationship" in ('mother', 'father', 'guardian', 'other'))

payments_online.name: payments_online
payments_online.value: ("payments"."method" = 'online') = ("payments"."provider" is not null and "payments"."provider_order_id" is not null)

payments_captured.name: payments_captured
payments_captured.value: ("payments"."status" = 'captured') = ("payments"."captured_at" is not null and "payments"."receipt_no" is not null)

payments_reference_length.name: payments_reference_length
payments_reference_length.value: "payments"."reference" is null or char_length("payments"."reference") between 1 and 100

schools_short_name_length.name: schools_short_name_length
schools_short_name_length.value: "schools"."short_name" is null or char_length("schools"."short_name") between 1 and 30

staff_profiles_job_title_length.name: staff_profiles_job_title_length
staff_profiles_job_title_length.value: "staff_profiles"."job_title" is null or char_length("staff_profiles"."job_title") between 1 and 80

staff_profiles_left_after_joined.name: staff_profiles_left_after_joined
staff_profiles_left_after_joined.value: "staff_profiles"."left_on" is null or "staff_profiles"."joined_on" is null or "staff_profiles"."left_on" >= "staff_profiles"."joined_on"

student_profiles_left_consistent.name: student_profiles_left_consistent
student_profiles_left_consistent.value: ("student_profiles"."status" = 'left') = ("student_profiles"."left_on" is not null and "student_profiles"."leave_reason" is not null)

timetable_slots_room_length.name: timetable_slots_room_length
timetable_slots_room_length.value: "timetable_slots"."room" is null or char_length("timetable_slots"."room") between 1 and 40

users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."username" IS NOT NULL
